Top-level: `{ "schema_version": 1, "description": "...", "tools": [ ... ] }`

Each tool has:
- `id` (string)

- `root` (string, present in launch, not in reference)
- `argv` (list, in launch)

- `owner` (string, optional — some reference rows have it, some launch rows have it, some don't)
- `effects` (string)
- `note` (string, optional)
- `prepend_env` (list, optional, in launch)
